title: Constraint: Weighted Packet Mix
constraints: Packets are SMALL (length 1–16), MEDIUM (17–128) or LARGE (129–255).
The kinds occur about 60 % / 30 % / 10 % of the time (checked over 1000 packets with a ±6 % tolerance), and the length always matches the kind.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: `kind dist { SMALL := 6, MEDIUM := 3, LARGE := 1 };` sets the weights.
Use implications (`->`) to tie the length range to the kind.
Putting the weights on `kind` rather than on `len` makes the mix independent of how wide each range is.
